request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
Backing is now the sum of the patrons' settled figures over their SETTLED claims dated within the
90 days up to and including the sheet's today (each at its frozen figure), 0.00 with none.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit

agent.result_text:
Backing now uses the new rule, and all 4 acceptance tests pass in `bin/e2e`.

A person's backing is now the sum of the frozen settled figures from their patrons' SETTLED claims dated in the last 90 days, counting the sheet's today. The window runs from today minus 89 days through today. With no such claims it shows 0.00. Because it uses each claim's frozen figure, a later rate change doesn't move it.

Backing was already worked out in the browser, so this was a front-end change only. The server, stored data and audit records are unchanged.
- **`src/main/frontend/src/app/core/claims.ts`:** a new helper, `backingFigure(c, today)`, gives a claim's frozen figure when it's settled and inside the window, and nothing otherwise.
- **`src/main/frontend/src/app/features/people/people-list.ts`:** `backingOf` now adds up those figures across the patrons' claims instead of the patrons' due-totals. I updated its comment and the header comment to match.

A settled claim is counted even if it's dated within one of the patron's holds; I read the request that way. A settled claim with no frozen figure (one that was n/a) adds nothing.

The one failed background task you may see was a wait loop I started and then stopped myself. It wasn't the test run.
